script_text: Stop, Pisces — your water is rising, and one message could flood the whole room. As a Water sign ruled by Neptune, you’re feeling the trine from Jupiter in your 5th House to Neptune in your 2nd House: money, pleasure, and intuition are syncing. But Mars in your 1st House is squaring Mercury retrograde in your 4th House, so a home or family conversation needs a softer tone. In love, Venus in your 5th House is conjunct the Moon and trining Neptune, so singles attract someone artistic, protective, or emotionally generous through food or music. Taken Pisces, choose privacy and sweetness; do not reopen an old argument. For money, Saturn in your 2nd House sextiles Mercury, helping you negotiate a bill, invoice, or lease detail into better shape. The blessing is a creative offer with earning potential.
